newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil up on futures amid dead holiday market.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil up on futures amid dead holiday market.

text.p: NWE gas oil was slightly firmer on Thursday in line with small gains in benchmark IPE futures, but trade in the region was minimal due to the Corpus Christi public holiday in the Roman Catholic parts of Germany, traders said.
June IPE gas oil was trading 25 cents higher at $173.25 a tonne at 1214 GMT.
Traders saw heating oil barge premiums around June IPE +$1.0/$2.0 for running refinery material for first half June.
Traders said the German regional holiday had killed trade.
"There's nothing going on I've come into get a bit of paperwork done," said one.
Netherlands traders painted a similar picture.
